name: Transfer Function Editor (Alpha Pins)
definition: A tool controlling the mapping from scalar voxel values S(x,y,z) to colour F(x,y,z) and opacity αF(x,y,z).
summary: The Transfer Function Editor (Alpha Pins) is an interactive tool that maps scalar values to color and opacity using a pin-based interface with ramps, hats, and blanks instead of continuous curves.
